quote:
Seasons of Use
End of May - mid-October, as weather and conditions allow
remark: Opens edge given two ways on the same page: Seasons of Use says 'End of May' (05-31) while the Reservations section says 'Reservations are available during the peak season (mid-May to late-September)' (05-15); opens left out. Closes mid-October vs chip 09-30: the calendar's 09-30 is the end of the reservable peak season. Page implies first-come outside the peak; entry booking has no fcfs.

quote: 2026: Open May 1 on first come/first serve basis. Reservations through Recreation.gov - last day November 30
remark: Year-specific (2026). Opens May 1 first-come before the calendar's 05-15. No closing date stated as such; last reservation night is November 30, so it is open at least that late. Recreation.gov: 30 sites first-come only.

quote: 2026: May 1 - October 18  -  Reservations available through recreation.gov
remark: Year-specific (2026) dates; chip 05-15/09-17. Recreation.gov notice: 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', so the entry's booking (no fcfs) is missing first-come sites. Page also notes parts of the North Kaibab RD are closed for the Dragon Bravo Fire (not this campground per the page).

Neither the BLM page nor the recreation.gov facility text (10000305) states an open season; both only say the area has 'cooler temperatures from October through April' (climate, not a season). BLM page confirms reservable sites 7, 9, 10-17 + group and first-come sites 1-6, 8, 18-23, so the calendar's Oct-Apr span is likely just the reservation window.

quote: 2026: May 1 - October 31  -  Reservations available through recreation.gov
remark: Year-specific (2026) dates; chip has only closes 09-17.

quote: The campground is generally open annually from May 1 through October 31.
remark: Chip 05-07/10-11; closes edge 20 days early. Page: '20 first come first serve sites.' 'Site Closed' header is the normal off-season. Page says 103 sites (note says 113).
Month-only season; chip has only closes 09-17. Page says nothing about reservations; first-come per the entry's booking.

quote:
Main campground open Year-Round
Horse Camp open from April 1 - November 1
remark: Chip 05-01/12-31 is a calendar artifact (the 2026 improvements closure the note cites through Oct 1, plus the 6-month booking horizon: 'can be made up to 6 months in advance'). Page no longer mentions a closure; it says firewood sales, dump station and shower building are unavailable. Horse camp (Mule Deer Loop) Apr 1 - Nov 1.

Chip 11-01/03-15 is the reservation season: 'Reservations are available Nov 1 through March 15.' Even-numbered sites first-come. The entry note's 'Seasonally closed ~June 1 to October' contradicts the page. Page also lists 'Bald Eagle Seasonal Closures - December 1 - June 30' (lake areas, not the campground season).
